name: tpl-not-co-existence-2-nogoal
task: Never both drop the key while the door is still closed and open the door.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: The task is a single rule ('never both drop the key before the door is open and open the door'), captured by the hard NotCoExistence(key_lost, door_open). key_lost is the event defined as a drop while the door is still closed, so no other clause is needed; the rule-only warning is valid since the task commands no unconditional goal.

texts: Never both key_lost and door_open happen during the episode.
